meta.title: Web Design Portfolio Kerala | Teknoppy Projects
meta.description: Browse Teknoppy's web design, ecommerce, and web application projects for clients across Kerala and the GCC, organized by category with real case studies.

body.html: Teknoppy has designed and built websites, online stores, and web applications for businesses across Kerala and the GCC. This page collects that work by category, so you can find examples close to your own industry before reaching out. Projects range from small business sites in Kochi to multi-location ecommerce stores serving customers in the UAE and Qatar, along with custom web applications built for businesses whose workflow didn't fit any off-the-shelf tool. Browse a category below, or head straight to Case Studies for the numbers behind specific projects.

items.title: Website Projects
items.text: Business and corporate websites for Kerala clients, ranging from single-page sites to multi-department platforms with dozens of pages and multiple content types, each one designed around the client's actual sales process.

items.title: WordPress Projects
items.text: Custom WordPress builds and migrations, including sites moved off outdated platforms without losing existing search rankings, traffic, or years of published content.

items.title: Ecommerce Projects
items.text: WooCommerce and Shopify stores for Kerala and GCC retailers, covering product catalogues, payment setup, checkout design, and post-launch conversion tracking.

items.title: Web Application Projects
items.text: Booking systems, customer portals, and dashboards for businesses running processes that off-the-shelf software couldn't handle, each one shaped around an existing workflow rather than forcing a new one.

items.title: SEO Case Studies
items.text: Search visibility work with ranking and traffic results, documented in full with real numbers on our dedicated case studies page.

paragraphs.html: Every project here links to a full write-up on our Case Studies page, with the results and numbers behind it. Design decisions on each project are led by the same senior team across every engagement, not rotated between freelancers. For more on the people delivering the work, see our Leadership and Certifications pages.

items.q: Can I see live examples of Teknoppy's work?
items.a: Yes. Browse projects by category above, or visit Case Studies for full write-ups with results.

items.q: Does Teknoppy have experience with GCC projects?
items.a: Yes. Alongside Kerala clients, Teknoppy has built websites and stores for businesses in the UAE and Qatar.

items.q: Do you show results alongside the design work?
items.a: Design examples live here. Ranking, traffic, and conversion numbers are documented separately on Case Studies, so each page stays focused on a single job and doesn't repeat the other's content.
